title: 인천광역시 중구와 미추홀구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:33255:20230221:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 인천광역시 중구와 미추홀구의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 33255, Feb. 21, 2023>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree enters into force on the date on which 30 days have elapsed after its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Administrative Dispositions, etc.)
(1) Any public notice, disposition, or other act issued or performed before this Decree enters into force by the head of the former local government or the head of an agency under that government in respect of an area incorporated into another local government shall be deemed to have been issued or performed by the head of the local government that acquires jurisdiction over that area pursuant to this Decree or by the head of an agency under that government.

(2) Any application, report, or other act submitted or made before this Decree enters into force to the head of the former local government or the head of an agency under that government shall be deemed to have been submitted or made to the head of the local government that acquires jurisdiction over the area incorporated into another local government pursuant to this Decree or the head of an agency under that government.

Article 3 (Relationship to Other Statutes and Regulations) Until statutes or regulations that define all or part of an autonomous district area changed pursuant to this Decree as their territorial or jurisdictional area are amended to reflect this Decree, the changed area shall be deemed, for the purpose of applying those statutes or regulations, to remain within the territorial or jurisdictional area of the autonomous district to which it belonged before the change.
